in_marathi.name: Dipayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dipayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word 'dipay', which means 'luminous' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Dipayan is the name of the god of knowledge and wisdom, Lord Ganesha, who is often depicted with a lit lamp, symbolizing knowledge and wisdom.
